prompt: Create a map of smoke density data from the database. Style it with explicit categories: Light (yellow), Medium (orange), Heavy (dark red), with semi-transparent fill.
criteria: Must call add_source_layer() with SQL query for smoke density
Must wait for layer processing before styling
Must call update_layer_style() with categorical FSL
FSL categories must be an explicit array ['Light', 'Medium', 'Heavy'] (not top-N shortcut)
FSL paint.color must be an array of 3 colors matching the categories
Colors must progress from yellow/light to red/dark
